//: Example configuration for a production Talky node.
Copy to %ProgramData%\Talky\appsettings.json and edit; that file wins over the one next to talky.exe.
Every key can also be set as an environment variable: TALKY_Server__DrainSeconds=60 sets Talky:Server:DrainSeconds.
See docs/configuration.md for the full reference.

Node.//Id: Optional. Pin only when an external system needs a stable node name. Default: {MachineName}-{4 random chars}.

Certificate.//Subject: Used only when Thumbprint is empty, e.g. talky.corp.local
Certificate.//PfxPath: Used when Source is Pfx, e.g. C:\ProgramData\Talky\talky.pfx
Certificate.//PfxPasswordEnvVar: Name of the environment variable holding the .pfx password, e.g. TALKY_PFX_PASSWORD
